[§15D-17] Equitable relief. A court may
issue an injunction or grant other equitable relief appropriate to ensure
substantial compliance with or enforce this chapter on application by:

(1) A covered voter alleging a grievance under this
chapter; or

(2) The attorney general of the State.

No award of attorney fees or costs shall be
permitted in any private cause of action initiated under this chapter. [L 2012,
c 226, pt of §1]
